notes.title: 🔥 Virtual Cottage 2! 🔥
notes.notes:
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2943180/Virtual_Cottage_2][img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/38802078/67b70df74d88be7efe810e4e584282ba34f778af.jpg[/img][/url]

Dear Friends,

When we launched Virtual Cottage in October 2020 as our first game/app on Steam, we had no idea where it would lead us.

We initially intended to create a screen blocker to help you focus on your work and avoid distractions like social media.

However, over the years, you have all shared valuable ideas, feature requests, and ways you interact with Virtual Cottage. It became clear to us that a significant overhaul was due.

So, we're thrilled to present Virtual Cottage 2! It comes with three different timers (Classic Timer, Stopwatch, and Pomodoro) and an improved To-Do List (rearrange tasks, create categories, and set up repeating daily routines). This time, you’ll also be able to add your music. 

But now, the most requested feature of all time (we heard you loud and clear!): [b]Cottage customization[/b]. 

You will be able to choose between different room layouts in the beginning and add more as time goes by. The game will also offer a wide selection of furniture items to place inside your home. We wanted you to have the ability to create your ultimate cozy space! You will get rewarded one item (and its colour variations) per day, simply by using Virtual Cottage. And yes, there will be pets…this time, you won't have to choose between them—you can have them all active simultaneously!

We are super excited about this and hope you are as well!! 

If you wanna be up-to-date with the development or leave us some more input, you’re welcome to join our [url=https://discord.com/invite/E2tR2mQ2KX]discord[/url] :)

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2943180/Virtual_Cottage_2

notes.title: Dogs Organized Neatly - Paper Edition!
notes.notes:
Dear Dog Organizers,

We are thrilled to announce the release of "Dogs Organized Neatly - Paper Edition" today! This physical rendition of the digital game provides a delightful and engaging experience for individuals and families alike, especially during the holiday season.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2741100/

The game mechanics remain faithful to the digital version, challenging you to strategically arrange adorable dog-shaped tiles within a grid-based layout. Simply print the provided PDF, cut out the dog cutouts, and embark on a captivating puzzle-solving adventure.

To elevate the game experience, unleash your creativity by crafting custom puzzle pieces. Glue the cutouts onto cardboard for enhanced durability, cut them from wood for a refined touch, or simply recolor the blank dog versions to personalize the game.

Embrace the spirit of tidiness and canine companionship with "Dogs Organized Neatly - Paper Edition."

As a small side note: We are working on our next "Organized Neatly"-title! Check it out and add it to your wishlist, please 😉

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2707110/Birds_Organized_Neatly/

notes.title: 🐾 Dogs Organized Neatly Now Available! 🐾
notes.notes:
Today is the day! We are happy to announce the release of Dogs Organized Neatly!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1597730/Dogs_Organized_Neatly/

We started working on this game in April of this year after so many of you requested more levels and cute doggos. Originally we were working on another project but put that on hold to make Dogs Organized Neatly. We thought it would be quite simple to make new graphics and to build some more puzzles but the whole project took waaay longer than anticipated.

Still, we put the same care into this game as we did with [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1369340/Cats_Organized_Neatly/]Cats Organized Neatly[/url] and had a lot of fun, coming up with all the dog names and personalities. We hope you’ll love them as much as we do! We can't wait for you to hear the new music aaaaah!

And if you [b]have a heart for cute doggos, please leave a review[/b]. It helps small indie devs like us out a lot since Steam will then show the game to more people. Thank you. <3
